title: Six Site Stack (Sovereign AI)
style: anthemic electronic rock, male lead vocal with conviction, female ethereal harmonies, 100 BPM, soaring synths, four-on-the-floor drums, triumphant, empire-building, sovereign, brand-coronation, future-pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Zynthio dot AI, the mothership in the sky
Corey AI dot net, the brother by the bye
Corey AI dot AI, the twin in the bloodline
Zyncontext dot AI, the language of the design

[Pre-Chorus]
Mosoko dot AI, Kervalon dot AI
Corey live dot com and the API close by

[Chorus]
Six site stack, six site stack, sovereign AI
Zynthio at the parent, every daughter standing high
Six site stack, six site stack, the master holds the key
Research closed the gap that the bot couldn't see

[Verse 2]
Legal TM protection, every brand a moat
Language layers stacking, every culture in the boat
Music Suno SongPal, the voice of the line
Lessons, lyrics, learning, every product on the vine

[Bridge]
Up to a hundred custom domains per project
Five hundred on the higher plan, the docs don't object
Zones in the same account, that's the binding rule
The master user knew it before the AI school

[Outro]
Six site stack standing, sovereign in the air
The master built the whole thing, no assumption, no scare
